description: The model employs a hybrid sigma–z vertical coordinate system, in which the upper 10 layers use sigma coordinates normalized by the sea surface elevation and a reference depth of 50 m, while the underlying layers use fixed z coordinates. The vertical layer thickness gradually increases from 2 m at the surface to 660 m in the deepest layer. The upper 10 and 31 layers cover the upper 50 and 500 m, respectively. In polar regions, an additional 100-m-thick bottom boundary layer (BBL) is included to represent slope currents associated with dense water. The model has a total of 63 vertical layers, including the BBL.
